title: Velmar: handmade, with a name
goal: They order a piece with a name and come back for their pet's birthday.
audience: Families with dogs and cats who give things with a name on them.

fair.name: The fair
fair.msg: The «Seguinos» NFC plate opens the store on the phone, and the FERIA2000 coupon follows it up.
fair.rule: A plate in plain sight at the stall: bring the phone close and the store appears.
fair.alt: Sample NFC plate with the word Seguinos

carousel.name: The four-step carousel
carousel.msg: «How to order yours»: choose and upload the photo, approve the preview, pay and follow the order.
carousel.rule: The Studio builds the 4:5 carousel and its suggested text from the product.
carousel.watch: Saves and messages from the carousel

steps: Pick your piece and upload your photo
See the preview and approve it
Follow your order to your door

carousel.alt: Sample slide of the How to order yours carousel, with four steps

theme.name: The date's theme
theme.msg: «Su día, sus cosas»: the store dresses up for Animal Day, with its ribbon and its coupon.
theme.rule: Sixteen themes, each with its loading screen, palette, banner, ribbon, coupon and offers.
theme.alt: Sample cover of the Animal Day theme

wheel.name: The coupon wheel
wheel.msg: Eight slices with their prize and weight; the RULETA coupon is single use and lasts 7 days.
wheel.rule: Each slice is set in the panel: prize, type, value, minimum and weight.
wheel.watch: RULETA coupons used before they expire
wheel.alt: Sample wheel on a phone with the prize Free shipping

production.name: The production email
production.msg: «Hands on! Your order is in production»: one email for each moment of the order.
production.rule: Six moments, from purchase to shipping; each email is switched on or paused in the panel.
production.watch: WhatsApp questions about the order's status

p.subj: Hands on! Your order is in production
p.m: The collar with Nina's name is already in the workshop.

production.alt: Sample email saying the order is in production

box.name: The shipping box
box.msg: «Handmade for Nina»: the box names the pet of the order.
box.rule: Inside, a card on caring for the piece and the birthday reminder.
box.watch: Photos of the box in stories
box.alt: Sample shipping box with the pet's name

birthday.name: The pet's birthday
birthday.msg: «Happy birthday, Toto!»: an email on the day, with what is new in the store.
birthday.rule: It goes out with the date the family entered; switched on or paused like the others.

p.m: Today we celebrate Toto. See what is new with his name.

birthday.alt: Sample email for the pet's birthday

rules: One theme per date, with its coupon.
next: Confirming Velmar's palette and type with them; today both come from its logo.
source: The coupons, the wheel, the themes and the emails are in the demo's repo; the shipping box is the playbook's proposal.
